commands.name: runtime.status
commands.summary: Inspect the local Production Runtime contract status.

commands.name: command.list
commands.summary: List machine-readable canonical command metadata.

commands.name: command.schema
commands.summary: Return one canonical command schema.

commands.name: workspace.status
commands.summary: Inspect whether the visible local Workflow is connected to the canonical Workspace Adapter.

commands.name: runtime.test.delay
commands.summary: Submit an internal no-side-effect delay task for Runtime durability tests.

commands.name: runtime.test.fixture-image
commands.summary: Create a deterministic local PNG fixture task for creative-host import verification without calling a Provider.

commands.name: task.get
commands.summary: Return one durable Runtime task by ID.

commands.name: artifact.locate
commands.summary: Verify a completed Runtime media artifact and return its durable local path for host import.

commands.name: task.inspect
commands.summary: Return one normalized ProductionTask backed by a durable ProductionRun and its StageRun checkpoint.

commands.name: task.resume
commands.summary: Reconnect to an active ProductionTask scheduler record without resubmitting completed provider stages.

commands.name: task.list
commands.summary: List durable Runtime tasks with status filtering and stable cursor pagination.

commands.name: task.cancel
commands.summary: Persist a cooperative cancellation request for one Runtime task.

commands.name: event.stream
commands.summary: Return durable Runtime events strictly after a resumable event ID.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Show human-readable command help.

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Show CLI file-bridge setup steps.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Install the Flovart Skill into one Distribution Target; it never configures an MCP server.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Diagnose CLI setup, Seedance 2.0 provider readiness, and the Workflow generation surface without exposing credentials.

commands.name: inspiration.search
commands.summary: Search curated Flovart prompt inspirations.

commands.name: inspiration.get
commands.summary: Return one curated inspiration entry by ID.

commands.name: prompt.enhance
commands.summary: Enhance a brief image/video prompt using Flovart agent preferences.

commands.name: batch.plan
commands.summary: Create a deterministic multi-shot generation plan from one brief.

commands.name: preferences.manage
commands.summary: Get, set, reset, or add favorite agent preferences.

commands.name: models.list
commands.summary: List agent-facing image/video model IDs routed through Flovart browser providers.

commands.name: model
commands.summary: List or inspect agent-facing model metadata.

commands.name: model.search
commands.summary: Search agent-facing model IDs by capability and query.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Inspect local frontend, Agent, and visible Workflow readiness.

commands.name: host.list
commands.summary: Discover local Agent Identity availability and its Distribution/Runtime projections without inspecting credentials.

commands.name: provider.status
commands.summary: Inspect Production Runtime provider readiness without exposing keys.

commands.name: agent-text.route.sync
commands.summary: Persist ordered non-secret Runtime routes for the built-in Flovart Agent text capability.

commands.name: production.dry-run
commands.summary: Compile one Director ProductionSpec into a durable ProductionRun, StageRun DAG, blockers, and Workflow Projection without Provider submission.

commands.name: production.status
commands.summary: Inspect one durable ProductionRun and its StageRun DAG.

commands.name: production.approve
commands.summary: Decide one production gate; approving route-plan and run-budget system gates unblocks execution.

commands.name: production.run
commands.summary: Execute one approved ProductionRun: the durable scheduler drives StageRuns through provider and local capabilities under the confirmed Route Plan and Run Budget.

commands.name: provider.begin-setup
commands.summary: Open provider setup in the local Runtime/WebUI.

commands.name: provider.select-model
commands.summary: Select configured image/video/text Product Model IDs (e.g. flovart:seedance-2).

commands.name: provider.test
commands.summary: Check provider readiness.

commands.name: research.topic.collect
commands.summary: Collect and rank recent topic evidence with explicit source coverage and durable local artifacts.

commands.name: workflow.project.list
commands.summary: List visible local Workflow projects through the Workspace Adapter.

commands.name: workflow.project.create
commands.summary: Create a visible local Workflow project through the Workspace Adapter.

commands.name: workflow.project.use
commands.summary: Select the active visible Workflow project.

commands.name: workflow.project.delete
commands.summary: Delete one visible local Workflow project.

commands.name: agent.turn
commands.summary: Delegate one turn to the user's built-in Flovart Agent; returns a summary, the tools it used, and the draft version.

commands.name: workflow.inspect
commands.summary: Inspect the visible Workflow graph with media and secrets redacted. Use summary=true for a light graph or nodeId for one node.

commands.name: workflow.selection.get
commands.summary: Read the current visible Workflow selection with media and secrets redacted.

commands.name: workflow.apply
commands.summary: Atomically apply revisioned idempotent document operations to one visible Workflow project.

commands.name: workflow.projection.get
commands.summary: Read the latest Runtime-authoritative Production Plan Projection for one Workflow project.

commands.name: workflow.node.create
commands.summary: Create one visible Workflow image/text/video/audio/config node.

commands.name: workflow.node.create-connected
commands.summary: Create one visible Workflow node and connect it from an existing node atomically.

commands.name: workflow.node.update
commands.summary: Patch one visible Workflow node for prompt or metadata fine-tuning.

commands.name: workflow.node.delete
commands.summary: Delete one visible Workflow node and incident connections.

commands.name: workflow.node.move
commands.summary: Move one visible Workflow node.

commands.name: workflow.node.resize
commands.summary: Resize one visible Workflow node.

commands.name: workflow.connect
commands.summary: Connect two visible Workflow nodes.

commands.name: workflow.disconnect
commands.summary: Delete one visible Workflow connection.

commands.name: workflow.select
commands.summary: Select visible Workflow node IDs.

commands.name: workflow.viewport.set
commands.summary: Set the visible Workflow viewport pan and zoom.

commands.name: workflow.focus.nodes
commands.summary: Center and fit one or more visible Workflow nodes in the viewport.

commands.name: workflow.node.run
commands.summary: Run one Workflow config node, or a batch of independent nodes via nodeIds under one confirmation, through browser providers.

commands.name: workflow.node.stop
commands.summary: Stop the active generation for one Workflow node.

commands.name: workflow.node.tool
commands.summary: Run one canvas secondary-processing tool on a visible Workflow node.

commands.name: asset.list
commands.summary: List durable artifacts of a pipeline run by kind / tags (with runId); without runId lists legacy local generated media history.

commands.name: generate.image
commands.summary: Generate one durable image Artifact through a trusted Product Model route.

commands.name: generate.images-batch
commands.summary: Generate multiple images for a Workflow from explicit prompt items.

commands.name: generate.video
commands.summary: Generate one durable video Artifact through a trusted Product Model route.

commands.name: video.status
commands.summary: Query a video/runtime job status.

commands.name: export.project
commands.summary: Export project metadata.

commands.name: pipeline.run.start
commands.summary: Start one Agent Video Pipeline run (brief artifact + one-time run budget confirmation: maxTasks, maxCostMicros, maxRounds). Every later pipeline tool call is recorded as a Step of this run.

commands.name: pipeline.run.get
commands.summary: Read one pipeline run trace: steps, spec versions with renders, review rounds, spend, blocker and the step to resume from.

commands.name: asset.import
commands.summary: Import authorized local files (screenshots, recordings, external Coding Agent output) into a pipeline run as sha256 durable artifacts.

commands.name: capture.ui
commands.summary: Open a localhost page (or a file in an authorized folder) in a local headless Chromium, run steps, and save screenshots or an MP4 recording as run artifacts. Requires confirmed: true.

commands.name: audio.tts
commands.summary: Voice script lines from speechText only (displayText stays for captions); returns measured duration and a voice parameter snapshot per line. Counts against the run task budget.

commands.name: audio.transcribe
commands.summary: Word-level transcription of an audio artifact (whisperx | hypit | fixture) into a hypit.transcript@1 evidence artifact.

commands.name: timeline.align
commands.summary: Align script lines to word-level evidence; returns timeline milliseconds per line and per action word.

commands.name: composition.patch
commands.summary: Revise the composition spec V2 (visual / text / captions / audio tracks) from baseVersion; locked clips need an explicit unlock with reason; with reviewRoundId only clips the findings point at may change.

commands.name: composition.render
commands.summary: Render one spec version locally: still (keyframe at atSec), draft, or final (requires a passing review of that version).

commands.name: media.probe
commands.summary: Probe an artifact: duration, codecs, resolution, black-frame and silence intervals, loudness, plus automatic issues against its spec.

commands.name: media.frames
commands.summary: Extract up to 6 real frames from a render by seconds, optionally side by side with another version and zoomed.

commands.name: review.submit
commands.summary: Submit one structured review round on a version: findings with atSec/range/clipId, layer, severity, issue, fix; verdict pass | revise | block.

commands.name: run.archive
commands.summary: Archive final render, every spec version, voice/music/sfx stems, rejected takes and reviews into a user folder with a sha256 manifest.
